title: Quiz — 11.1 Measures of Center and Variation

questions.prompt: Which measure of center is most affected by an outlier?
hints: It is the average of all values.
Extreme values pull it toward them.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The mean is most affected because it includes every value in the calculation.

questions.prompt: The median of the data set 3, 5, 1, 5, 1, 1, 2, 3, 15 is ___.
hints: Order the numbers from least to greatest.
Find the middle value of the nine numbers.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The ordered list is 1,1,1,2,3,3,5,5,15; the median is 3.

questions.prompt: What is the range of the data set 19, 20, 21, 22, 22, 24, 25, 25, 27, 27, 32, 48?
hints: Range = maximum − minimum.

questions.prompt: In the standard deviation formula, what is the mean of the squared deviations called?
hints: It is the square of the standard deviation.
Starts with 'v'.

questions.prompt: If every value in a data set is multiplied by 5, what happens to the standard deviation?
hints: Multiplying scales all measures of center and spread.
The spread stretches by the same factor.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The standard deviation is also multiplied by 5.

questions.prompt: If 10 is added to every value in a data set, the range ___.
hints: Adding a constant shifts all values equally.
The difference between max and min remains the same.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The range stays the same because both the maximum and minimum increase by 10.

questions.prompt: Which measure of center can be used for non‑numerical data?
hints: It finds the most frequent category.
You cannot average words.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The mode can be used for non‑numerical data, such as favorite color.

questions.prompt: A data set has a mean of 30. Each value is increased by 7. What is the new mean?
hints: Add the constant to the original mean.

questions.prompt: A small standard deviation indicates that the data values are:
hints: Small σ means less variation.
Values are close to the average.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: A small standard deviation means the data are clustered around the mean.

questions.prompt: The mode of the data set 5, 3, 5, 1, 5, 1, 2, 3, 15 is ___.
hints: Count the frequency of each number.
Which number appears three times?
questions.feedbackIfWrong: 5 appears three times; the mode is 5.

questions.prompt: When a data set has an even number of values, the median is:
options: The average of the two middle values
The sum divided by the count
hints: With an even count, there are two middle numbers.
You must take the mean of them.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: For an even number of values, the median is the mean of the two middle values.

questions.prompt: What is the range of the data set 8.2, 10.1, 2.6, 4.8, 2.4, 5.6, 7.0, 3.3?
hints: Range = maximum − minimum.

questions.prompt: Which of the following is a measure of variation?
hints: It describes spread, not center.
It is the square root of the variance.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: Standard deviation is a measure of variation.

questions.prompt: If every value in a data set is multiplied by 0.5, the mean is multiplied by ___.
hints: Multiplication scales the center by the same factor.
The original mean times 0.5.

questions.prompt: A data set has a standard deviation of 0. What word describes the data values?
hints: There is no variation.
All values are the same.
